title.english: The Letter on the Kitchen Table

pairs.target: sè lā dú xìn shí , guō lǐ de dòuzǐ zhǔkāi le .
pairs.english: While Sela read the letter, the beans in the pot came to a boil.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉读信时，锅里的豆子煮开了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi qǐshēn qù jiēgài , tā shēnshǒu ànzhù zhǐ jiǎo , jiào tā bǎ huǒ tuì yìdiǎn , bié quán chè . tā zhào zuò , huílái fāxiàn tā réng tíng zài nà yíduàn , zuǐchún wúshēng dì dòng , xiàng zài tì zhǐ shàng de rén bǎ háizi hǒng shuì .
pairs.english: Tavi rose to lift the lid. She held the paper corner and told him to lower the fire a little, not remove it all. Returning after doing so, he found her still at that passage, lips moving silently as if soothing the child to sleep for the person on the page.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维起身去揭盖，她伸手按住纸角，叫他把火退一点，别全撤。他照做，回来发现她仍停在那一段，嘴唇无声地动，像在替纸上的人把孩子哄睡。

pairs.target: tā jīntiān yìzǎo huí de huī ào , lùshang méi xiān qù bó yà nàlǐ , bǎ xiě hǎo què méi jì de xìn hé liǎngfēng yuán xìn yíbìng fàngdào zhuōshàng . sè lā xiān wèn shìbushì yòu yǒushì , zhè cái tīng tā cóngtóu jiǎngwán .
pairs.english: He had come back to Ash Hollow early that morning, without stopping at Boya’s, and laid his unposted letter and both originals together on the table. Sela first asked if something else had happened, then heard the whole account.
pairs.hanzi: 他今天一早回的灰坳，路上没先去博娅那里，把写好却没寄的信和两封原信一并放到桌上。瑟拉先问是不是又有事，这才听他从头讲完。

pairs.target: chuāngfèng lǐ jìnlái yí dàoguāng , zhào zài fú lán xìn shàng de shuǐ hén . sè lā jiāng zhǐ lüèlüè zhuǎn kāi , wèn tā nàxiē kànbùqīng de zì yǒuméiyǒu ràng biérén rèn guò . tǎ wéi shuō yīwén yě kàn le , yǒu liǎnggè zì bùgǎn rèn .
pairs.english: A shaft of light came through the window gap onto the water stains on Fulan’s letter. Sela turned the sheet slightly and asked if anyone else had tried the unclear words. Tavi said Iven had looked too, but could not confidently identify two characters.
pairs.hanzi: 窗缝里进来一道光，照在芙兰信上的水痕。瑟拉将纸略略转开，问他那些看不清的字有没有让别人认过。塔维说伊文也看了，有两个字不敢认。

pairs.target: " nà xiān bié tián . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “Then leave them blank for now,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “那先别填。”她说。

pairs.target: tā jiāng jiù xìn fàng píng , zìjǐ què méi mǎshàng fàngshǒu . tǎ wéi cóng bāo lǐ zhǎochū chāo hǎo de nà fèn , xiǎng gěi tā huàn , sè lā kàn le tā yìyǎn , shuō zìjǐ shǒu shì gānjìng de .
pairs.english: She flattened the old letter but did not let go at once. Tavi found his copy in the bag to offer instead; Sela glanced at him and said her hands were clean.
pairs.hanzi: 她将旧信放平，自己却没马上放手。塔维从包里找出抄好的那份，想给她换，瑟拉看了他一眼，说自己手是干净的。

pairs.target: tā liánmáng shuō búshì pà zhège , huà yì jí , lián zhǐ yě niē zhòu le . sè lā zhōngyú xiào le yíxià , jiāng liǎngzhī shǒuzhǎng tānkāi gěi tā kàn , yòu bǎ zhǐ tuī dào zhuōzi zhōngyāng .
pairs.english: He hurried to say that was not his worry, crumpling the copy in his fluster. Sela finally smiled, showed him both open palms, and pushed the letter to the table’s centre.
pairs.hanzi:
他连忙说不是怕这个，话一急，连纸也捏皱了。
瑟拉终于笑了一下，将两只手掌摊开给他看，又把纸推到桌子中央。

pairs.target: " wǒ yǎng nǐ nàme dà , xiànzài ná fēngxìn hái dé xiān gěi nǐ yàn shǒu ? " " wǒ méi nà yìsī . " " zhīdào . zuòxià . "
pairs.english: “I raised you all this way, and now you must inspect my hands before I hold a letter?” “I did not mean that.” “I know. Sit down.”
pairs.hanzi:
“我养你那么大，现在拿封信还得先给你验手？”
“我没那意思。”
“知道。坐下。”

pairs.target: tā zuò huíqù . tā yòng zhǐjié pèng le pèng xìn shàng xiě bù jiǎo de dìfāng , shuō tā xiǎoshíhòu yě zuàn guò , chī wánmǎn shǒu de fànlì , quán cā zài tā wéiqún shàng .
pairs.english: He sat again. She tapped the cloth-corner passage with a knuckle and said he used to clutch cloth too, wiping his rice-covered hands all over her apron after eating.
pairs.hanzi: 他坐回去。她用指节碰了碰信上写布角的地方，说他小时候也攥过，吃完满手的饭粒，全擦在她围裙上。

pairs.target: hòulái bó yà xián xǐ dé fèijìn , gěi tā shuān guò yìxiǎokuài bù , tā què nìngkě qù jiū tā de xiùzǐ .
pairs.english: Later Boya, tired of the washing, tied a small cloth to him, but he preferred tugging her sleeve.
pairs.hanzi: 后来博娅嫌洗得费劲，给他拴过一小块布，他却宁可去揪她的袖子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bú jìde shuān bù de shì . tā shuō dāngrán , tā nà shíhòu lián zìjǐ yào shénme dōu búhuì jiǎng , zhǐyǒu búyào huì shuō dé hěn xiǎng .
pairs.english: Tavi did not remember the tied cloth. Of course, she said; back then he could not say what he wanted, only shout what he did not.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维不记得拴布的事。她说当然，他那时候连自己要什么都不会讲，只有不要会说得很响。

pairs.target: tā dītóu kàn nà yìháng zì . yuánběn xiǎng cóng lǐmiàn rènchū zìjǐ , sè lā yì jiǎng , yǎnqián chūxiàn de quèshì jiālǐ nàtiáo xǐ jiù de wéiqún .
pairs.english: He looked down at that line. He had wanted to recognize himself in it, but Sela’s words brought only the worn, washed apron at home before his eyes.
pairs.hanzi: 他低头看那一行字。原本想从里面认出自己，瑟拉一讲，眼前出现的却是家里那条洗旧的围裙。

pairs.target: tā hūrán bù zhīdào gāi gāoxìng , háishì nánguò , liǎngyàng dōu jǐ zài xiōngkǒu , shuí yě bùkěn xiān ràngkāi .
pairs.english: Suddenly he did not know whether to feel glad or sad; both crowded his chest, neither willing to make room.
pairs.hanzi: 他忽然不知道该高兴，还是难过，两样都挤在胸口，谁也不肯先让开。

pairs.target: " tā nà shíhòu qù le yú wān . " tā shuō . sè lā diǎntóu . " wǒ jiù zài xiǎng , yàoshi chàyìdiǎn ——"
pairs.english: “She went to Elmbay then,” he said. Sela nodded. “I keep thinking, if it had only been a little—”
pairs.hanzi:
“她那时候去了榆湾。”他说。
瑟拉点头。
“我就在想，要是差一点——”

pairs.target: tā shuōbúxiàqù . chàyìdiǎn shénme , chà jǐtiān , jǐliàngchē , jǐgè méiyǒu tīngjiàn de míngzì , tā lián nà yíduànlù yě shuō bù quán .
pairs.english: He could not continue. A little what: days, wagons, names nobody had heard? He could not even describe the whole stretch of road.
pairs.hanzi: 他说不下去。差一点什么，差几天、几辆车、几个没有听见的名字，他连那一段路也说不全。

alignment.english: could not even describe the whole stretch of road

pairs.target: sè lā jiāng tā de wǎn nálái , yǎo le yìdiǎn dòuzǐ , ràng tā xiāncháng xiándàn . tǎ wéi cháng wán , shuō chàdiǎn yán . tā zìjǐ cháng le yìkǒu , shuō gòu le , tā zhè yìnián zuǐ yuè chī yuè zhòng .
pairs.english: Sela brought his bowl, ladled a few beans and asked him to taste the seasoning first. Tavi said it needed salt. She tasted it herself and said it was enough; his taste had grown saltier this past year.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉将他的碗拿来，舀了一点豆子，让他先尝咸淡。塔维尝完，说差点盐。她自己尝了一口，说够了，他这一年嘴越吃越重。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén zhēng le bànjù , tā cái fāxiànzìjǐ búzài píng zhe nà kǒuqì . guō lǐ de rèqì jiāng chuāngshàng de guāng chōngsàn , xìn réng fàngzài zhuōshàng , méiyǒu yīncǐ xiāoshī .
pairs.english: After half an argument, he realized he was no longer holding his breath. Steam scattered the window light; the letter still lay on the table, unchanged by it.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人争了半句，他才发现自己不再屏着那口气。锅里的热气将窗上的光冲散，信仍放在桌上，没有因此消失。

pairs.target: chīfàn shí , tā bǎ kǎohé tōngguò de shì yě shuō le . sè lā wèn xiànzài néng zuò shénme , tā zhàobiǎo shàng de yìsī jiǎng , zhǐnéng zài hézhǔn de xiǎo jiājù shàng zuò zhǐdìng de huó , yǒurén guǎn , bùnéngzìjǐ qù dòng jiù dōngxī .
pairs.english: Over the meal he told her about passing the assessment too. Sela asked what he could do now; he explained the sheet’s limits: assigned work on approved small fixtures, supervised, with no independent work on old things.
pairs.hanzi: 吃饭时，他把考核通过的事也说了。瑟拉问现在能做什么，他照表上的意思讲，只能在核准的小夹具上做指定的活，有人管，不能自己去动旧东西。

pairs.target: " yǒurén kěn ràng nǐ zuòshì le . " tā shuō . tā diǎntóu , děng zhe tā jiē yíjù bié chěngnéng . tā què wèn yào buyào ná jiàn gèng nàimó de wàiyī , jiùyī zhǒu shàng dōu kuài tòu le .
pairs.english: “Someone is willing to give you work now,” she said. He nodded, expecting a warning not to overreach. Instead she asked if he wanted a tougher coat; the elbows of his old one were almost worn through.
pairs.hanzi:
“有人肯让你做事了。”她说。
他点头，等着她接一句别逞能。她却问要不要拿件更耐磨的外衣，旧衣肘上都快透了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō děng yǒu huó zàishuō , tā jiāng kuàizi gēxià , jiào tā chī wán xiān shì , bié děng chūmén nàtiān cái shuō xiùzǐ duǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi said to wait until there was a job; she set down her chopsticks and told him to try it after eating, rather than complain the sleeves were short on departure day.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说等有活再说，她将筷子搁下，叫他吃完先试，别等出门那天才说袖子短。

pairs.target: wǔhòu tā huàn yīshang , tā zuòzài chuāng biān bǔ yìxiǎo jié xiàn , zhēn cóng bùlǐ chūlái , yòu jìnqù . wàiyī lüèkuān , tái gēbo shí méiyǒu qiānzhù jiān .
pairs.english: In the afternoon he changed while she sat by the window stitching a short seam, the needle going out of the cloth and in again. The coat was a little loose, not pulling at his shoulders when he raised his arms.
pairs.hanzi: 午后他换衣裳，她坐在窗边补一小截线，针从布里出来，又进去。外衣略宽，抬胳膊时没有牵住肩。

pairs.target: sè lā ràng tā zhuǎn bànquān , kànqīng bèishàng jiù bǔdīng hái jiēshi , biàn jiào tā tuōxiàlái , shuō lǐng biān zài fèng liǎng zhēn .
pairs.english: Sela had him turn halfway, checked that the old back patch was sound, then told him to take it off for two more stitches at the collar.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉让他转半圈，看清背上旧补丁还结实，便叫他脱下来，说领边再缝两针。

pairs.target: tā chèn zhèshí gěi wū yà xiě huíxìn . xiān xiè tā fān chū jiù xìn , zài wèn fú lán dāngshí xiě de shōuxìn gōngfáng , jiūjìng zài yú wān chénglǐ háishì wàikù fùjìn .
pairs.english: Meanwhile he wrote to Wuya, thanking her for finding the old letter, then asking whether Fulan’s receiving works had been inside Elmbay or near the outer depot.
pairs.hanzi: 他趁这时给乌娅写回信。先谢她翻出旧信，再问芙兰当时写的收信工房，究竟在榆湾城里还是外库附近。

pairs.target: zhī wèn tā zhīdào de , yě shuōmíng zìjǐ míngbái nàlǐ hòulái sàn le , búhuì ná jiù dìzhǐ zhíjiē qù zhǎo rén .
pairs.english: He asked only what she knew, explaining he understood it had later dispersed and would not search for people directly at the old address.
pairs.hanzi: 只问她知道的，也说明自己明白那里后来散了，不会拿旧地址直接去找人。

pairs.target: sè lā tīng tā niànwán , zhī jiào tā bǎ tóng jiē de huíxìn chù xiě qīngchǔ . xiàwǔ chūmén mǎi yán , tāmen yìqǐ jīngguò shōuxìn pù , tǎ wéi bǎ xìn jiāo jìnqù , kàn rén shōu jìn dāngtiān de dàizǐ , cái gēnzhe tā wǎng jiēkǒu zǒu .
pairs.english: After hearing it, Sela only told him to write his Copperstep return address clearly. Out buying salt that afternoon, they passed the mail shop together; Tavi handed in his letter, watched it go into that day’s bag, then followed her toward the street corner.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉听他念完，只叫他把铜阶的回信处写清楚。下午出门买盐，他们一起经过收信铺，塔维把信交进去，看人收进当天的袋子，才跟着她往街口走。

alignment.english: write his Copperstep return address clearly

pairs.target: huíjiā hòu , sè lā jiāng fú lán de yuán xìn zhuāng huí yóubù tào . tǎ wéi wèn néng bunéng xiān liúzài tā zhèlǐ , zìjǐ dài chāoběn huíqù .
pairs.english: Back home, Sela returned Fulan’s original letter to its oilcloth sleeve. Tavi asked if he could leave it with her for now and take the copy back.
pairs.hanzi: 回家后，瑟拉将芙兰的原信装回油布套。塔维问能不能先留在她这里，自己带抄本回去。

pairs.target: tā zhèhuí méiyǒu kāiwánxiào , qǐshēn cóng guì lǐ zhǎochū yìzhī bāo zhēnxiàn de jiù tiěhé , pù le gānjìng bù , fàngjìnqù , yòu ràng tā kàn fàngzài nǎ yìcéng .
pairs.english: This time she did not joke. She rose, found an old sewing tin in the cupboard, lined it with clean cloth, put the letter inside and showed him which shelf it was on.
pairs.hanzi: 她这回没有开玩笑，起身从柜里找出一只包针线的旧铁盒，铺了干净布，放进去，又让他看放在哪一层。

pairs.target: yèlǐ tā shuì zài yuánlái de dìfāng , wàiyī dā zài yǐ shàng , lǐng biān yǐjīng fènghǎo . gébì yǒurén xiào , lóuxià yǒu chē jīngguò , sè lā fānshēn shí chuángbǎn xiǎng le yìshēng .
pairs.english: That night he slept in his old place, the coat over a chair, its collar finished. Someone laughed next door, a cart passed below, and Sela’s bed creaked when she turned.
pairs.hanzi: 夜里他睡在原来的地方，外衣搭在椅上，领边已经缝好。隔壁有人笑，楼下有车经过，瑟拉翻身时床板响了一声。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu náchū chāoběn zài kàn , zhī zài hēiàn lǐ yìng le yìshēng . " zěnme ? " tā wèn . " méishì . " tā shuō . guò le yíhuìer , tā yòu shuō wǎnān .
pairs.english: He did not take out the copy again, only answered once into the dark. “What?” she asked. “Nothing,” he said. After a while he said goodnight too.
pairs.hanzi:
他没有拿出抄本再看，只在黑暗里应了一声。
“怎么？”她问。
“没事。”他说。
过了一会儿，他又说晚安。
